summary: Potential furniture tip-over risks identified on the credenza and table lamp.

hazards.title: Unanchored Credenza
hazards.detail: Long console cabinet beneath gallery wall may lack anti-tip wall brackets.
fixSteps: Secure the cabinet frame directly into wall studs using L-brackets.
Verify stability by gently pulling forward from the top edge.

hazards.title: Unsecured Table Lamp
hazards.detail: Large table lamp sits near edge of credenza and can easily be pulled or knocked over.
fixSteps: Apply museum putty or adhesive pads beneath the lamp base.
Reroute the electrical cord tightly against the back wall.

products.name: Furniture Anti-Tip Wall Straps
products.reason: Prevents credenza from tipping over if climbed or pulled.
products.searchQuery: furniture anti tip straps heavy duty

products.name: QuakeHold Museum Putty
products.reason: Secures tabletop lamp and decor items to prevent falling.
